title: Technical Project Manager - Microsoft Dynamics 365
description:
**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat

**Job Type:** Full Time

**Department:** Project management

**About Simform:**

Simform is a premier digital engineering company specialising in Cloud, Data, AI/ML, and Experience Engineering to create seamless digital experiences and scalable products. Simform has strong capabilities across Microsoft, Google Cloud, and Databricks. With a presence in 6 countries, Simform primarily serves North America, the UK, and the Northern European market. Simform is well-recognised as one of the most reputed employers in the region, having created a thriving work culture with a high work-life balance that gives a sense of freedom and opportunity to grow.

**Role Overview:** We are a digital product engineering company that partners with clients to create innovative, high-performing software solutions. We’re looking for a Technical Project Manager to **lead end-to-end Dynamics 365 implementations** for global clients, owning delivery from discovery to go-live and acting as a trusted partner to customer stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**:

* Lead **D365 CE** (Sales, Customer Service, Field Service) and/or **D365 F&O** implementations across the full lifecycle: **discovery, fit-gap analysis, solution design, build, UAT, go-live, and hypercare**.
* Drive **solutioning** with architects and functional consultants: configuration vs. customization decisions, **data migration**, **integrations** (Dataverse, Azure, Logic Apps, third-party systems), and security models.
* Own **planning, scope management, prioritization, and change control**, keeping delivery on time, within budget, and aligned to business outcomes.
* Manage **cross-functional teams** (functional, technical, QA) and ensure **quality, validation, and release readiness** through structured testing and **ALM practices** (solution management, Azure DevOps).
* Be the primary **customer-facing lead**: run workshops, steering meetings, and status reporting, manage expectations, and proactively flag **risks and dependencies**.

**Must Have**:

* Strong experience in **technical project/delivery management and solution leadership**.
* Hands-on knowledge of **system design, architecture, cloud, web, mobile, and modern engineering practices**.
* Proven experience leading **Agile/Scrum teams and complex end-to-end projects**.
* Excellent **client communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and escalation-handling skills**.
* Strong understanding of **estimation, governance, risk, scope, quality, and delivery metrics**.
* Ability to lead and mentor **cross-functional technical and non-technical teams**.
* Strong **AI-first mindset** with practical experience applying AI and automation across the SDLC.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* **8+ years** in IT delivery, with **4+ years managing Dynamics 365 projects** and at least **2 full-cycle implementations**.
* Strong **technical depth** in the D365 data model, configuration, extensibility, and integration patterns.
* Solid grounding in **Agile/Scrum and hybrid delivery**, with exposure to **Microsoft Success by Design** or Sure Step as a plus.
* **Power Platform** experience (**Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Copilot Studio**) is a strong plus.
* Excellent **communication, clarity of thought, problem-solving**, and **client engagement** skills.
* Certifications such as **MB-910** or **PL-200** are a plus.

**Why Join Us:**

* Young Team, Thriving Culture
* Flat-hierarchical, friendly, engineering-oriented, and growth-focused culture.
* Well-balanced learning and growth opportunities
* Free health insurance.
* Office facilities with a game zone, in-office kitchen with affordable lunch service, and free snacks.
* Sponsorship for certifications/events and library service.
* Flexible work timing, leaves for life events, WFH and hybrid options.

title: Project Lead-Interiors
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Project Manager - Corporate InteriorsJLL Project & Development Services (PDS) | Gujarat, IndiaAbout JLLJones Lang LaSalle (JLL) is a leading professional services firm that specializes in real estate and investment management. Our Project & Development Services (PDS) team delivers comprehensive project and program management services across diverse industries and geographies.
  
Position OverviewWe are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead corporate interior projects across Gujarat. This role requires a strategic thinker with strong execution capabilities who can manage end-to-end project delivery while maintaining the highest standards of quality, cost control, and client satisfaction.
  
Key ResponsibilitiesProject Planning & Execution
  
The Project Manager will oversee all phases of corporate interior projects from initiation through closeout. You will develop comprehensive project plans, establish timelines and milestones, coordinate design development with architects and consultants, and ensure alignment with client objectives and brand standards. Managing project scope, schedule, budget, and quality parameters while anticipating and mitigating risks will be central to your role.
  
Stakeholder Management
  
Serving as the primary point of contact for clients, you will build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders including client representatives, design consultants, contractors, vendors, and internal JLL teams. You will conduct regular progress meetings, provide transparent communication on project status, and manage expectations effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
  
Financial & Contract Management
  
You will be responsible for preparing detailed cost estimates and budget forecasts, monitoring project expenditures and cash flows, reviewing and approving contractor invoices and change orders, and ensuring projects are delivered within approved budgets. Administering contracts and ensuring compliance with terms and conditions will be essential aspects of this role.
  
Quality & Compliance
  
Ensuring that all work meets JLL quality standards and client specifications is paramount. You will conduct regular site inspections and quality audits, verify compliance with building codes, safety regulations, and statutory requirements, coordinate testing and commissioning activities, and manage the punch list and defect rectification process.
  
Team Leadership
  
You will lead project teams including consultants, contractors, and JLL staff members. Building collaborative working relationships, providing clear direction and guidance, monitoring team performance, and fostering a culture of excellence and accountability will be key leadership responsibilities.
  
Required QualificationsEducation & Experience
  
Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Interior Design, or Construction Management is required. A minimum of 8-12 years of experience in project management with specific focus on corporate interiors, office fit-outs, or commercial projects is essential. Proven track record of successfully delivering multiple projects simultaneously in the Gujarat region is highly preferred.
  
Technical Competencies
  
Strong knowledge of interior construction methodologies, materials, and finishes is required. Proficiency in project management tools such as MS Project, Primavera, or equivalent software, along with advanced skills in MS Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) is expected. Thorough understanding of building codes, safety regulations, and quality standards applicable to commercial interiors is necessary. Familiarity with MEP systems coordination and integration within interior spaces is valued.
  
Professional Skills
  
Excellent communication and presentation abilities in English and Hindi (Gujarati is advantageous) are required. Strong negotiation and conflict resolution capabilities, along with exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail, are essential. Financial acumen with experience in budgeting, cost control, and forecasting is necessary. Client-focused mindset with commitment to service excellence is fundamental to success in this role.
  
Preferred QualificationsPMP or equivalent project management certification demonstrates professional commitment. Experience working with multinational corporations or large-scale corporate clients is valuable. Knowledge of sustainable building practices and LEED/IGBC certification processes is beneficial. Exposure to design-build or integrated project delivery methods is advantageous.
  
What We OfferOpportunity to work with leading multinational and domestic corporate clients on prestigious interior projects. Collaborative work environment with experienced professionals committed to excellence. Professional development opportunities including training programs and certifications. Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience and qualifications. Exposure to diverse project types across various industry sectors.
  
LocationGujarat (Ahmedabad/Gandhinagar preferred, with willingness to travel across Gujarat as needed)
  
JLL is an Equal Opportunity Employer
  
We are committed to creating an inclusive work environment that reflects the diversity of our clients and communities. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, race, religion, age, disability, or other protected characteristics.
  
To apply, please submit your resume and cover letter through JLL's career portal or contact your local HR representative for application procedures.
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Project Engineer
description:
**PROJECT ENGINEER – JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Company**: ARYAANYA PMC **Location**: Ahmedabad HO/ Project Sites

**Department**: Project Management **Reports To**: Project Manager

**ROLE PURPOSE**

The Project Engineer is responsible for supporting the execution and monitoring of construction projects by ensuring quality, timeline adherence, and coordination between contractors, consultants, and the client team. The role focuses on site supervision, technical verification, and disciplined reporting aligned with project management standards.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Project Execution & Site Supervision**

* Supervise day-to-day construction activities at the project site

* Ensure work execution as per approved drawings, specifications, and project plans

* Monitor progress of civil, structural, and finishing work

* Ensure contractor work complies with project timelines and quality standards

**Quality Control**

* Inspect materials and workmanship at site

* Ensure adherence to approved drawings and technical specifications

* Report quality deviations and coordinate corrective actions with contractors

**Coordination & Communication**

* Coordinate with contractors, architects, structural consultants, and project stakeholders

* Assist the Project Manager in resolving site issues and execution bottlenecks

* Ensure clear communication between site teams and management

**Project Monitoring & Reporting**

* Maintain daily and weekly site progress reports

* Track project milestones and update the Project Manager on delays or risks

* Support preparation of progress reports for client review meetings

**Documentation**

* Maintain site records including drawings, approvals, and site instructions

* Ensure documentation of inspections, site instructions, and contractor submissions

* Support preparation of measurement records and work completion verification

**Safety & Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to site safety guidelines

* Report safety violations or risks immediately

* Promote disciplined site practices and compliance with construction standards

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education** - Bachelor’s Degree / Diploma in Civil Engineering

**Experience -** 2–6 years of experience in construction project execution or site supervision

Experience in residential, commercial, or mixed-use real estate projects preferred.

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

* Strong understanding of construction drawings and site execution

* Knowledge of civil construction processes and materials

* Basic project planning and coordination capability

* Good communication and site coordination skills

* Ability to prepare structured site reports

**PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS**

The Project Engineer will be evaluated on:

* Site execution discipline and supervision quality

* Timely reporting and documentation

* Coordination with contractors and consultants

* Adherence to project timelines and quality standards

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

* Primarily site-based role

* May involve travel between project locations

* Requires regular interaction with contractors and project stakeholders

title: Sr. Project Engineer (Electrical Substation & Transmission Line)
description:
Job Description: Senior Project Engineer (Electrical Substation & Transmission)

**Company:** Hi Tech Transport Private Limited (Hi Tech Transpower)

**Position Title:** Senior Project Engineer

**Work Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat (Office-Based with Mandatory Site Visits)

**Target Candidate:** Belong to & currently residing in **Ahmedabad ONLY**

**Experience Required:** 3 to 5 Years in Substation Design / Substation Construction / Transmission Lines

**Educational Qualification:** B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical Engineering (Mandatory)

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly capable **Electrical Engineer** to lead substation and transmission line projects directly from our Head Office in Ahmedabad. This role combines office-based technical design review, end-to-end procurement, and complete project coordination, supplemented by mandatory site visits as required by project milestones.

Key Responsibilities

* **Office-Based Engineering Leadership & Project Management:**
* Overall lead substation and transmission line projects from our Ahmedabad Head Office—serving as the central point of contact for technical management, progress tracking, and project execution.
* Lead project schedules, milestone tracking, and inter-departmental workflows from initiation to successful commissioning.
* **Drawing & Technical Design Review:**
* Read, review, analyze, and interpret Single-Line Diagrams (SLD), substation layout drawings, schematic diagrams, panel wiring, equipment layouts, earthing grids, and cable schedules for Extra-High Voltage (EHV) and High-Voltage (HV) substations and transmission lines.
* **Procurement & Technical Material Management:**
* Manage procurement activities including technical evaluation of vendor quotations, Preparation / Verification of Bill of Quantities (BOQ/BOM), and technical comparison statements for substation equipment, towers, and hardware.
* Coordinate with vendors and suppliers for technical clearance, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) approval, and timely dispatch of site materials.
* **Project Coordination & Approvals:**
* Actively coordinate drawing approvals, technical specs, and commercial clearances between clients (e.g., Torrent Power, GETCO, Discoms), internal engineering teams, consultants, and site execution teams.
* **Mandatory Site Visits & Execution Supervision:**
* **Mandatory periodic site visits** to active construction sites to monitor progress, conduct quality audits, resolve site technical bottlenecks, and verify execution against approved drawings.
* Supervise key execution stages during site visits, including equipment erection, grounding/earthing mat installation, transformer placing, gantry/structure assembly, and line stringing.
* **Site Quality, Standards & Compliance:**
* Ensure that all electrical execution, procurement specs, and testing procedures strictly conform to IS/IEC standards, utility specifications, safety protocols, and project deadlines.

Mandatory Candidate Eligibility Criteria

* **Education:** B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical Engineering from a recognized university.
* **Experience:** 3 to 5 years of core experience in Substation Design, Construction, or Transmission Line Execution.
* **Location Constraint (Strict):** **Must belong to and currently reside in Ahmedabad.** or seeking relocation to Ahmedabad.
* **Drawing Mastery:** Expert ability to read and interpret complex EHV/HV electrical drawings and layout schematics independently.
* **Mobility:** Willingness and capability to perform mandatory site visits as project needs demand.

Pay: ₹448,000.00 - ₹720,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Internet reimbursement
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

title: Program Manager
description:
Job Description: Program Manager

**Company:** Vihat Creation  
**Industry:** Advertising, Brand Activation & Event Management  
**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat  
**Experience:** 4–7 years (preferred)  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

About Vihat Creation

Vihat Creation is a full-scale advertising, brand activation, and event management agency established in 2015. With a team of 25+ professionals and over 300 projects delivered across India, we specialize in creating impactful campaigns through strategic planning, creative execution, and on-ground implementation.

Our services include roadshows, mobile van campaigns, product sampling, retail and in-shop activities, dealer and retailer branding, outdoor advertising, product launches, corporate events, and promotional activations.

Job Purpose

The Program Manager will be responsible for planning, coordinating, executing, and monitoring multiple advertising, branding, activation, and event campaigns. The role requires strong project management skills, client coordination, team leadership, budget control, and the ability to ensure timely, high-quality execution across multiple locations.

Key Responsibilities1. Program Planning & Execution

* Plan and manage end-to-end execution of brand activation campaigns, roadshows, mobile van activities, sampling programs, retail branding, dealer boards, retailer boards, and events.
* Develop project timelines, execution plans, resource requirements, and delivery schedules.
* Coordinate multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring timely completion and quality standards.
* Ensure all campaign activities are executed according to approved client briefs and brand guidelines.

2. Client Management

* Act as the primary coordination point between clients and internal teams.
* Understand client requirements and translate them into actionable execution plans.
* Share project updates, progress reports, photographs, and execution feedback with clients.
* Handle client concerns, resolve operational issues, and maintain strong professional relationships.

3. Team & Vendor Management

* Coordinate with field teams, supervisors, promoters, production teams, logistics partners, fabricators, printers, and event vendors.
* Allocate responsibilities and monitor team performance across project locations.
* Ensure materials, vehicles, branding assets, manpower, and equipment are available on time.
* Conduct team briefings and provide clear execution instructions.

4. Budgeting & Cost Control

* Prepare project budgets, cost estimates, and resource plans.
* Monitor actual expenses against approved budgets.
* Negotiate with vendors and suppliers to maintain cost efficiency without compromising quality.
* Track purchase orders, vendor bills, team expenses, travel costs, and other project-related expenditures.
* Ensure timely submission of expense statements and project cost reports.

5. On-Ground Monitoring & Quality Control

* Monitor campaign execution through field visits, supervisor reports, photographs, videos, and digital tracking tools.
* Ensure branding materials and installations meet approved specifications.
* Verify attendance, product sampling, stock movement, sales data, and daily activity reports wherever applicable.
* Identify execution gaps and take immediate corrective action.

6. MIS & Reporting

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly program status reports.
* Maintain project trackers for timelines, budgets, manpower, materials, stock, sales, sampling, and campaign performance.
* Prepare campaign closure reports with photographs, key metrics, expenditure summaries, and client feedback.
* Maintain accurate documentation for internal reviews and client presentations.

7. Business Coordination & Growth

* Identify opportunities to improve campaign efficiency and service quality.
* Support the business development team with proposals, execution plans, costing, and presentations.
* Build long-term relationships with clients, vendors, and execution partners.
* Recommend innovative activation ideas and operational improvements.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Graduate in Business Administration, Marketing, Event Management, or a related field.
* 2–3 years of relevant experience in advertising, BTL marketing, brand activation, events, retail execution, or project management.
* Strong planning, coordination, negotiation, and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and client-handling skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and project tracking tools.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, teams, and vendors simultaneously.
* Willingness to travel for campaign monitoring and multi-location execution.
* Strong ownership, accountability, attention to detail, and a results-oriented mindset.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Program Manager's performance will be evaluated on:

* Timely execution and completion of assigned projects.
* Adherence to approved budgets and cost efficiency.
* Quality of campaign execution and compliance with client briefs.
* Client satisfaction and repeat business.
* Accuracy and timeliness of MIS and reporting.
* Vendor performance and resource utilization.
* Effective team coordination and issue resolution.
* Achievement of campaign targets, including sales, sampling, reach, and engagement wherever applicable.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work on diverse national and regional brand campaigns.
* Exposure to advertising, retail marketing, experiential marketing, and event management.
* A collaborative and growth-oriented work environment.
* Opportunities to take ownership of projects and develop leadership capabilities.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated resume along with details of their relevant experience and current/expected salary at the contact details on vihatcreation.india@gmail.com.

**Vihat Creation**  
*Creating visibility. Building engagement. Delivering impact.*

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

title: Project Manager
description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission\-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.



For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry\-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real\-world results and help move society forward.



\#


### **Senior Project Manager – HVAC (Chillers)**


**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat **Department:** Operations / Project Management **Experience:** 12\-18 Years **Industry:** HVAC, Building Solutions, Chillers, MEP Projects


### **Job Summary**



We are seeking an experienced **Senior Project Manager \- HVAC** to lead and manage end\-to\-end execution of large\-scale HVAC and Chiller projects. The ideal candidate should have extensive experience in **HVAC systems, Chillers, project execution, project management, stakeholder management, and commercial aspects of projects**. The role requires ensuring timely project delivery, quality compliance, customer satisfaction, and profitability.


### **Key Responsibilities**


### **Project Management \& Execution**


* Lead multiple HVAC and Chiller projects from initiation to commissioning and handover.
* Develop project execution plans, schedules, resource allocation plans, and risk mitigation strategies.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and as per contractual requirements.
* Monitor project progress and resolve technical, commercial, and operational issues.
* Conduct periodic project review meetings with internal and external stakeholders.

### **Technical Management**


* Oversee installation, testing, commissioning, and handover of HVAC and Chiller systems.
* Review engineering drawings, technical specifications, BOQs, and project documentation.
* Ensure compliance with HVAC industry standards, safety regulations, and quality requirements.
* Provide technical guidance to project engineers and site teams.

### **Customer \& Stakeholder Management**


* Act as the primary point of contact for customers, consultants, contractors, and internal teams.
* Build strong relationships with key stakeholders and ensure customer satisfaction.
* Manage client expectations, change requests, and escalation handling.

### **Commercial \& Financial Management**


* Monitor project budgets, costs, cash flow, and profitability.
* Review project variations, claims, and billing milestones.
* Ensure timely invoicing, collections, and project closure.

### **Team Leadership**


* Lead and mentor project managers, engineers, and site execution teams.
* Drive performance, productivity, and accountability across project teams.
* Promote a culture of safety, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

### **EHS \& Quality Compliance**


* Ensure adherence to EHS standards and organizational safety policies.
* Drive quality control processes throughout project execution.
* Conduct audits and corrective actions to ensure compliance.

### **Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline.
* PMP/Prince2 certification will be an added advantage.
* Strong understanding of HVAC systems, Chillers, Air Handling Units (AHU), Cooling Towers, Pumps, and Building Automation Systems.

### **Required Experience**


* 12\-18 years of experience in HVAC/Chiller project execution and project management.
* Proven track record of managing large commercial, industrial, healthcare, pharmaceutical, data center, or infrastructure projects.
* Hands\-on experience in Chiller installation, commissioning, and lifecycle project management.
* Experience managing project teams, contractors, consultants, and customers.

### **Key Skills**


* HVAC Project Management
* Chiller Systems
* Project Execution
* Project Planning \& Scheduling
* Contract Management
* Cost Control \& Budgeting
* Stakeholder Management
* Risk Management
* Installation \& Commissioning
* MEP Projects
* EHS Compliance
* Team Leadership
* Customer Relationship Management

### **Preferred Industry Background**



Candidates from HVAC, Building Technologies, MEP Contracting, Chiller Manufacturing, Industrial Cooling, Data Centers, Pharmaceuticals, Commercial Buildings, or Infrastructure Projects will be preferred.
